fusions.name: Full Sail Ram
fusions.desc: Rams a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, up to 2.2 times that at full reach. Every hit is a critical hit. Its damage rises +5% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max +25%).

fusions.name: Wake Slap
fusions.desc: Throws up a wash that deals 3 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, with a 25% chance to leave each [Slowed] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Fair Wind
fusions.desc: Increases your attack speed by 20% for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Ballast Trim
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 10%. Your armour rises by 8%.
